footer.tagline: AI-powered couples therapy available 24/7. Work through conflict, rebuild trust, and grow together — on your schedule.

home.heroSubtitle: AI-powered couples therapy available 24/7. Work through arguments, improve communication, and strengthen your relationship — no waitlists, no scheduling, start anytime.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to strengthen your relationship
home.featuresSubtitle: Purpose-built for couples working through conflict, powered by the latest in AI therapy research.
home.feature1Desc: Start a session anytime — 2am after an argument, Sunday morning before brunch, or during your lunch break. No appointments needed.
home.feature2Desc: Receive real-time analysis of communication patterns, emotional cues, and conflict dynamics to guide healthier dialogue.
home.feature3Desc: Interact with a warm, natural-sounding AI therapist that responds with empathy and evidence-based guidance.
home.feature4Title: Start Anytime, Pay by the Minute
home.feature4Desc: No fixed session lengths. Talk for as long as you need — 10 minutes or an hour. You only pay for the time you use.
home.feature5Desc: Your therapist remembers previous sessions, tracking progress and building on breakthroughs over time.
home.feature6Desc: End-to-end encryption and strict privacy protocols keep your conversations completely confidential.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Get started in minutes. No waitlists, no scheduling hassles.
home.step1Desc: Pick a focus area — couples, family, or group conflict resolution.
home.step2Desc: Speak naturally. Our AI recognizes each participant and follows the conversation.
home.step3Desc: Get real-time insights, reframing suggestions, and evidence-based techniques.
home.step4Desc: Review session summaries, track patterns, and see your communication improve over time.
home.testimonialsSubtitle: Hear from real people who have transformed their relationships.
home.testimonial1Quote: We were skeptical about AI therapy, but TogetherTherapy helped us break communication patterns we'd been stuck in for years. It felt surprisingly natural.
home.testimonial2Quote: Having a neutral third party available at any hour made all the difference. We can resolve disagreements before they escalate.
home.testimonial3Quote: Our teenage kids actually engage with the sessions. The AI has a way of making everyone feel heard without taking sides.
home.testimonial4Quote: We had our first baby and everything fell apart between us. Three sessions in and we were finally talking instead of snapping. The 2am availability saved us during those sleepless nights.
home.testimonial5Quote: We almost called off the wedding over money disagreements. TogetherTherapy helped us build a financial plan we both feel good about. Worth every penny.
home.testimonial6Quote: As a same-sex couple, we were nervous about judgment. The AI therapist was completely neutral and focused on our actual issues. We felt safe from the first minute.
home.useCasesSubtitle: Real situations where an always-available therapist makes all the difference.
home.useCase1Desc: Arguing over sleep schedules, feeding routines, and who does what. Get support navigating the biggest adjustment of your lives.
home.useCase2Desc: Spending habits, savings goals, and financial stress. Work through money conflicts before they erode your relationship.
home.useCase3Desc: Feeling unheard, misunderstood, or stuck in the same argument. Learn new ways to listen and be heard.
home.useCase4Desc: Chores, mental load, and feeling like the balance isn't fair. Find practical solutions that work for both of you.
home.useCase5Desc: After a betrayal, breach of trust, or hurtful words. Start the healing process with guided, neutral support.
home.useCase6Desc: Step-parenting disagreements, co-parenting boundaries, and merging different family cultures under one roof.
home.ctaSubtitle: Take the first step toward better communication today. No commitment required — just a single session to see the difference.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: We believe every couple deserves access to quality therapy — without barriers of cost, scheduling, or stigma.
about.ourStoryP1: Together Therapy was born from a simple observation: most couples' arguments don't need years of therapy — they need a skilled mediator available at the moment tension arises. But traditional therapy is expensive, hard to schedule, and carries stigma that keeps many couples from seeking help.
about.ourStoryP2: We set out to build something different. By combining advances in voice recognition with therapeutic AI trained on decades of couples therapy research, we created an AI therapist available 24/7 that can help guide difficult conversations in real time.
about.ourStoryP3: Today, Together Therapy has facilitated over 125,000 sessions, helping couples break destructive communication patterns and build stronger, healthier connections.
about.missionEnd: to every relationship that needs it — anytime, anywhere.
about.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide everything we build.
about.value1Desc: Every interaction is grounded in compassion. Our AI is trained to validate emotions before guiding toward solutions.
about.value2Desc: Our methods draw from proven therapeutic frameworks including CBT, EFT, and the Gottman Method.
about.value3Desc: Your conversations are encrypted end-to-end. We never sell data or share session content with third parties.
about.value4Desc: Built to support all relationship structures — couples, families, co-parents, roommates, and teams.
about.value5Desc: Our AI therapists improve with every session, incorporating the latest research in conflict resolution.
about.value6Desc: We never take sides. Our AI is designed to be a fair mediator that helps every participant feel heard.
about.disclaimerText: Together Therapy is an AI-powered support tool and is not a replacement for licensed professional therapy. Our AI therapists are not licensed mental health professionals. If you or someone you know is in crisis or experiencing abuse, please contact emergency services or the
about.disclaimerEnd: immediately. Together Therapy is designed to supplement — not replace — professional care.
about.ctaSubtitle: Try a single session with no commitment. See how AI-guided conflict resolution can transform your relationships.

howItWorks.title: How
howItWorks.subtitle: From choosing your therapist to tracking your progress, here's exactly how our AI-powered therapy sessions work.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Browse our team of AI therapists, each with unique specialties and therapeutic approaches. Read their bios, learn about their methods, and pick the one that resonates with your needs.
howItWorks.step1Detail: Whether you need trauma-sensitive guidance, CBT-based communication coaching, or mindfulness-based mediation, there's a therapist for you.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Purchase minutes and optionally provide a session prompt describing what you'd like to focus on.
howItWorks.step2Detail: Session prompts help your therapist tailor their approach from the very first moment.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Simply talk. Our voice recognition technology captures your conversation — no buttons to press, no turn-taking.
howItWorks.step3Detail: The AI therapist listens to the room and responds naturally, creating a conversational flow.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Your AI therapist listens, analyzes communication patterns, and responds with evidence-based insights, reframing suggestions, and de-escalation techniques.
howItWorks.step4Detail: Responses are spoken aloud in a natural voice, creating a conversational flow that feels like having a real therapist in the room.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Your therapist remembers. Across sessions, the AI tracks patterns, triggers, breakthroughs, and goals.
howItWorks.step5Detail: Each session picks up where the last one left off, creating continuity that deepens the therapeutic process.
howItWorks.step6Desc: After each session, access a full transcript and AI-generated summary in your dashboard. Track your progress over time.
howItWorks.step6Detail: Your data is encrypted and private. Only you can access your session history.
howItWorks.ctaSubtitle: Choose a therapist and start your first session in minutes.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent
pricing.subtitle: No subscriptions. No hidden fees. Buy time bundles and use them whenever you need — pay by the minute.
pricing.included3: Pay only for the minutes you use
pricing.included5: Session memory that carries across future sessions
pricing.faq1A: Buy a time bundle (1, 3, or 10 hours). Minutes are deducted based on how long each session lasts. Talk for 10 minutes or an hour — you only pay for what you use.
pricing.faq2Q: Can I use Together Therapy with more than two people?
pricing.faq2A: Absolutely. Our voice recognition supports multiple participants — couples, families, co-parents, roommates, and small teams.
pricing.faq3A: Yes. All session data is encrypted and stored securely. We never sell your data or share session content with third parties.
pricing.faq4Q: Is this a replacement for real therapy?
pricing.faq4A: No. Together Therapy is an AI-powered wellness tool that supplements — not replaces — professional therapy.
pricing.faq5A: No. Buy time bundles with no subscriptions, contracts, or hidden fees. Your minutes never expire.
pricing.faq6Q: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faq6A: We accept all major credit and debit cards via Stripe, including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.
